reference.note: Crops are tight on the ring; the prompt forbids copying the grey velvet scene of the sample photos (owner: no grey towel/velvet).

geometry: Read from close crops of the owner's sample: flat band, 1.5 mm thick (owner). The outer face is fine satin (lightly brushed, almost matte). Along ONE edge only the satin steps down to two slim, rounded, mirror-polished ribs with one fine groove between them; the ribs take about a quarter of the width and run all the way around. The opposite edge is square and satin. Interior mirror-polished comfort fit. No stones, no milgrain, no engraving.

visualLanguage.etsyGuidance: Seller Handbook (Nov 2025, quoted by eRank): first photo landscape or square, product centred with an even border so the thumbnail survives the 1:1, 4:3 and 3:4 crops; all photos the same shape; at least 2000 px.
visualLanguage.eonHouseStyle: home studio, morning window light, natural shadows, clear glass with soft offset reflections; pale oak, linen, plaster white (Comet/Frostline, owner 2026-09-27)
visualLanguage.ringStyle: Quiet satin face + one bright edge: light should run along the polished ribs while the satin stays soft. Frames are lit so the rib edge is the brightest line in the picture.
visualLanguage.framing: Square 2048 like every EON listing. The ring stays inside the central 70% so Etsy's 4:3 and 3:4 crops never cut it.
banned: grey towel / grey velvet / grey fabric (owner)
text, numbers or hallmark stamps drawn by the model
flowers or props that hide the ring edge
colour-only recolours of another listing's frames (owner 2026-10-15)
ownerDirection2026-10-15: görseller bire bir aynı olmamalı (no colour-only copies across listings)
daha cool daha farklı ortamlar, yüzüklere metallere uyumlu tonlar, ürünü ortaya çıkaracak şekilde; metal yüzeyi doğal kontrollü yansımalar, doğal gölgeler

perMetal.Y: warm travertine, sand raw linen, honey oak, olive sprig, amber glass; low warm sun
perMetal.W: blue-grey slate, brushed concrete, frosted glass, eucalyptus, water droplets; cool overcast daylight
perMetal.R: pink-beige marble, blush plaster, dusty-rose linen, matte pale ceramic, dried rose; soft late-afternoon light

visualLanguage.lightingRule: one large soft window light + white bounce card: smooth controlled gradient highlights, no blown specks, natural contact shadow; one prop at most, out of focus

frames.purpose: Search thumbnail: the shape reads as a wedding band at 170 px; satin face and the bright double rib both visible.
Shows the ring worn: proportion on a man's ring finger, satin against skin.
Craftsmanship: the step, the two polished ribs and the groove fill the frame.
Width choice: four rings 4, 5, 6, 7 mm side by side, narrowest to widest.
Thickness and step profile: ring lying flat like a coin so the 1.5 mm rim and the stepped edge read.
Everyday wear: hand holding a glass of water at a table in morning light.
Facts in one place: karat, widths, sizes, thickness, fit, engraving.
True size: ring pinched between thumb and index finger, about a fingertip wide (about 2 cm across).
Comfort fit and solid gold inside: view into the ring at about 60 degrees.
Wedding pair: 4 mm and 7 mm together in a hand-blown glass dish.
Color options: yellow, white and rose rings together (same file in all three listings; the description says the listing is for the color in its title).
Personalisation: the four engraving fonts set on the interior photo.

promptCore: Copy the ring exactly from the reference photos: a flat solid gold wedding band, 6 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick. The outer face is a fine satin finish (lightly brushed, almost matte). Along ONE edge only, the satin face steps down to two slim, rounded, mirror-polished ribs separated by one fine groove; together they take about a quarter of the band width and run unbroken all the way around. The opposite edge is square and satin. The inside is mirror-polished. No stones, no milgrain, no engraving, no stamps. Use the reference photos only for the ring's shape and finishes; do not copy their grey velvet, background, scene or camera angle.

heroPrompt.Y: Photorealistic product photograph of one 14K yellow gold wedding band. {promptCore} Scene: the ring stands upright at a three-quarter angle on a thick slab of clear glass resting on a pale oak table, soft morning window light from the left, a natural soft shadow and a faint offset reflection in the glass, plaster-white wall softly out of focus behind. The light runs along the polished ribs as one bright line while the satin face stays soft. The ring is centred and fills about half of the frame, with an even margin on every side. No text, no watermark.
